originalProposals.reason: Plants releasing oxygen that humans and animals need to breathe identifies air as a basic need (G3-L-6 air) and living things depending on plants/environment for that need (G3-L-7 environment). G3-L-7 food-and-shelter is a spurious breathe/eat hit and is not used as evidence. G6-M-5 air-mixture composition and G8-L-8 diagram oxygen cycle are not taught. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single identical card ID.

evidence.quote: Plants release oxygen into the air, and without them, humans and animals would have less fresh air to breathe.
